bullets: Kernels Represent a dot product of two vectors in a higher dimensional feature space
Any Machine Learning Model that contains dot product of input samples can be kernelized
Instead of calculating dot product between input vectors, calculate dot product between input vectors after mapping them to higher dimensional space
Different Kernel functions are based on different mapping functions
Calculations of mapping and calculations of dot product in higher dimensional space are very expensive
Use Kernel Trick to minimize both calculations (at no extra cost)
equations: a^T b -> phi(a) and phi(b) -> phi(a)^T phi(b) = K(a,b)
